name: claude-code-lens
description: Puts tsc, linter and secret-scan diagnostics in the result of every Edit and Write, so Claude fixes what it broke in the same turn

stopGuard.title: Stop guard
stopGuard.description: When a turn ends with errors it introduced, send Claude back once to fix them

tidy.title: Tidy at turn end
tidy.description: Run the project's configured fixers and formatters (eslint --fix, biome, prettier, ruff, gofmt, rustfmt) on the files a turn edited

gitGuard.title: Git guard
gitGuard.description: Deny git commit and git push while files this session edited still have errors
